title: What if you drank only coffee for a week?

lines.text: What if you drank nothing but coffee... for an entire week?
Day one. You feel unstoppable. Heart racing, hands buzzing... and honestly? You love it.
lines.label: DAY 1

lines.text: Day three. You've barely slept, you haven't eaten, and your hands shake so much you spill half of every cup.
lines.label: DAY 3

lines.text: Day five. With zero food, your body starts burning its own fat... and then its muscle.
lines.label: DAY 5

lines.text: Day seven. Just to stay hydrated, you're drinking twelve cups a day. That's nearly three times the safe caffeine limit.
lines.label: DAY 7

lines.text: Coffee can keep you awake. It just can't keep you alive.
